title: Functorial support-quotient pullback maps and site comparison
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work with ordinary module sheaves over the constant ring sheaves $A_T$ on small representatives of the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For a closed immersion $a:C\hookrightarrow T$ of schemes whose open complement $j:T\setminus C\hookrightarrow T$ is quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], put
$$Q^\tau_{T,C}=\operatorname{coker}(j_!A_{T\setminus C}\to A_T),\qquad r^\tau_{T,C}:A_T\twoheadrightarrow Q^\tau_{T,C},\quad\tau=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet},$$
where the arrow is the open-inclusion map and $j_!$ is extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Let $f:T'\to T$ be a scheme morphism and $a':C'\hookrightarrow T'$ another such closed immersion, with quasi-compact open complement, such that $f\circ a'$ factors through $a$. Use constant-coefficient module pullbacks [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. In each topology there is a unique module morphism
$$c^\tau_{f;C,C'}:f^*Q^\tau_{T,C}\longrightarrow Q^\tau_{T',C'}\quad\text{with}\quad c^\tau_{f;C,C'}\circ f^*r^\tau_{T,C}=r^\tau_{T',C'},$$
under the canonical identification $f^*A_T\cong A_{T'}$. In the etale topology its stalk is the identity $A\to A$ on $C'$ and the zero map to zero off $C'$. If $C'=T'\times_TC$ as a closed subscheme [def-pc-fibre-product], this morphism is an isomorphism in both topologies. These morphisms are identities for identity maps of pairs and satisfy
$$c^\tau_{f\circ g;C,C''}=c^\tau_{g;C',C''}\circ g^*c^\tau_{f;C,C'}$$
for $g:T''\to T'$ carrying $C''$ into $C'$, assuming all three complements quasi-compact, under the canonical inverse-image composition comparisons.

Let $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be the site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and let $\alpha_{T,C}:\nu_T^*Q^{\mathrm{et}}_{T,C}\xrightarrow{\sim}Q^{\mathrm{proet}}_{T,C}$ be the comparison carrying $\nu_T^*r^{\mathrm{et}}_{T,C}$ to $r^{\mathrm{proet}}_{T,C}$ [lem-pur-support-quotient-flat]. Then, under $\nu_{T'}^*f_{\mathrm{et}}^*\cong f_{\mathrm{proet}}^*\nu_T^*$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback],
$$c^{\mathrm{proet}}_{f;C,C'}\circ f_{\mathrm{proet}}^*\alpha_{T,C}=\alpha_{T',C'}\circ\nu_{T'}^*c^{\mathrm{et}}_{f;C,C'}.$$
All asserted composition and comparison compatibilities are equalities of ordinary sheaf morphisms. Neither flatness of $f$ nor reducedness of the closed supports is assumed.
